name: aiperf-vendored-ui-deps
description: Dependabot bookkeeping only. The dashboards under src/aiperf/api/static*/ and src/aiperf/operator/ui/ have no build step -- each file below is hand-vendored (fetched, hash-pinned, and rewritten to a relative import) by tools/vendor_ui_deps.py, not installed via npm. This manifest exists so Dependabot can open version-bump PRs against that script; there is no node_modules, no bundler, and nothing here is ever `npm install`ed. When Dependabot bumps a version here, update the matching MANIFEST entry's `version`/`url`/`sha256` in tools/vendor_ui_deps.py and run `tools/vendor_ui_deps.py --update <name>` to re-fetch and re-pin the actual vendored file.
